items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: Dickie gave the band a lot of drive, a lot of pure, good horn

ctx.x: What did Dickie give your band when it comes to sound?
I don't know. Dickie gave the band a lot of drive, a lot of pure, good horn and (Inaudible) a lot of humor.
Humor? Yeah. Anybody else give humor to the band, if you can recall?
